name: slopgate
description: Catch AI code smell before Codex finishes.

interface.shortDescription: Catch AI code smell before Codex finishes.
interface.longDescription: SlopGate scans the current git diff for empty catches, hardcoded secrets, disabled type checks, placeholders, test focus/skip, and debug leftovers. It blocks Codex from finishing or committing while blockers remain.
defaultPrompt: Check this change with SlopGate before calling it done.
